hospital_name: Los Angeles County Department of Health Services

evidence.quote: Charity care is available for persons with income up to 200% of FPL; however, ATP has no upper income cap for eligibility for discounted care, but liability increases on a sliding scale above 200% FPL.

tiers.description: ATP (LA County patients): no upper income cap; liability increases on a sliding scale above 200% FPL, not greater than Medicare/Medi-Cal amount for the same service. Specific liability charts are not included.

DPP (out-of-county patients): income up to 400% FPL; liability not greater than Medi-Cal payment for the service, or 95% of charges if Medi-Cal amount exceeds charges. SSDPP (sensitive services, US residents outside LA County): up to 400% FPL on the ATP sliding scale.

evidence.quote: Charity care is available for persons with income up to 200% of FPL; however, ATP has no upper income cap for eligibility for discounted care, but liability increases on a sliding scale above 200% FPL.

asset_test.details: Resources/assets such as bank accounts and real property are not counted in ATP, DPP and SSDPP determinations.

evidence.quote: Resources/assets (i.e., bank accounts, real property, etc.) are not counted in the determination.

residency.area: ATP is for Los Angeles County residents (including those transitioning to or unhoused in LA County). Out-of-county patients use DPP (up to 400% FPL); SSDPP is for US residents outside LA County.

evidence.quote: The ATP program is the FAP for LA County patients that offers both free (charity) care and discounted care.
ATP applications can be made retroactively with no time limitation.

presumptive_eligibility: Patients with Restricted (Limited Scope) Medi-Cal with no share of cost who are LA County patients are presumptively eligible for ATP.
how_to_apply: In person or by phone by visiting or calling one of the LA Health Services (DHS) facilities and speaking with Patient Financial Services staff; no specific address or phone number given.
warnings: Policy has no application deadline; retroactive applications have no time limitation, so days set to 0.
Discount ceiling is not a single number: ATP (LA County) has no upper cap above 200% FPL, while DPP and SSDPP for non-LA County patients cap at 400% FPL, so discount.fpl_max_percent is left null.
ATP liability charts by FPL are not included, so specific discount percentages are unavailable.
Document includes Policy 530 (collections) and application forms; only Policy 515 was used for eligibility rules.
Policy is also reproduced in Spanish.
